# Generated files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `modules.json` | Canonical generated registry (all classified modules + `dashboard` subset) |
| `modules.generated.js` | Same registry as `window.WIZARD_REGISTRY` for static pages |

Both are produced by `node scripts/wizard-lab.mjs generate`. Do not edit them by hand. Verification fails if they drift from manifests.

`index.html` is hand-authored chrome plus `dashboard.js`. Cards inside it must come from the registry, not a second inventory.

`tools/wizard_orbs/index.html` is generated by `python3 tools/wizard_orbs/build.py` from `src/template.html`. Adapter hooks belong in both.
